question: Which of the following cities was the venue for the meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation's Heads of State Council in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bishkek**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bishkek is the capital and largest city of Kyrgyzstan.
 
• The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation's Heads of State Council meeting in 2019 was held in Bishkek on June 13-14.
 
• This was the 19th meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO).
 
• Bishkek is known for its Soviet-era architecture and is a key political and economic center in Central Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)**

 
 
• The SCO is a Eurasian political, economic, and security alliance, originally founded in 2001 in Shanghai.
 
• It was founded by six countries: China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan.
 
• The main goals of the SCO are to strengthen relations among member states, promote cooperation in political affairs, economics and trade, scientific-technical, cultural, and educational spheres, and ensure peace, security, and stability in the region.
 
• India and Pakistan became full members of the SCO in 2017.
 
 
 
• **Heads of State Council**
 
 
• The Heads of State Council (HSC) is the highest decision-making body in the SCO.
 
• The HSC meets once a year and adopts decisions and guidelines on all important matters of the organization.
 
• The HSC meetings are attended by the heads of state of the SCO member countries.
 
• These meetings often result in the signing of strategic documents and agreements that shape the future direction of the organization.
 
 
 
• **Bishkek**
 
 
• Bishkek is the capital of Kyrgyzstan, located in the Chui Valley at the northern edge of the Kyrgyz Ala-Too range.
 
• The city is a major cultural and economic hub in Central Asia.
 
• It is known for its wide boulevards, marble-faced public buildings, and Soviet-style apartment blocks.
 
• Bishkek hosts various international conferences, summits, and events, making it a significant player in regional diplomacy.
